source.test: no MSC 1 equivalent — import_existing_paper_server's own added validation

notes: MSC 1's actual scanServerDirectory (AppViewModel+ServerImport.swift:235-364) never rejects a jar-less directory — it falls through to an empty Paper result with a nil jar/version instead (confirmed by a whole-tree grep: the string "no Java server JAR found" does not appear anywhere in MSC 1). This fixture instead characterizes import_existing_paper_server (crates/msc-application/src/import.rs), Phase 4's own narrower, registration-only Rust function — deliberately scoped to reject rather than register an unusable lifecycle target (see the module's own doc comment: it intentionally does not copy/unzip/scan worlds the way MSC 1's scan does). expected.errorContains is real, tested behavior (crates/msc-application/tests/paper_import.rs:213) and must not change; only this source pointer was corrected — it previously mis-attributed a Phase-4-invented validation to MSC 1 as if it were ported oracle behavior. See docs/msc2/config-migration/raw-import-behavior.md's own note on this for the contrast with the read-only raw-import scan path, which does port scanServerDirectory's real no-rejection behavior.
